driftwood_pole.name: Driftwood Pole
driftwood_pole.description: A crude fishing rod fashioned from washed-up wood.

bamboo_caster.name: Bamboo Caster
bamboo_caster.description: Light and flexible, perfect for beginners.

perks.passive: Slightly increased catch rate in rivers

angler_whisper.name: Angler's Whisper
angler_whisper.description: A balanced rod that whispers secrets of the shallows.

perks.passive: Shows a small hint when fish are about to bite

coral_weaver.name: Coral Weaver
coral_weaver.description: Woven with living coral that pulses with sea magic.

perks.passive: Increased chance to find coral treasures

tide_caller.name: Tide Caller
tide_caller.description: Crafted with coral and blessed by the tides themselves.

perks.passive: Occasionally attracts rare fish from deeper waters

frost_fisher.name: Frost Fisher
frost_fisher.description: Imbued with eternal ice, perfect for cold waters.

storm_breaker.name: Storm Breaker
storm_breaker.description: A rod charged with lightning, crackling with power.

perks.passive: Has a chance to double your catch during storms

void_fisher.name: Void Fisher
void_fisher.description: Dark energy swirls within this mysterious rod.

perks.passive: Can catch shadow fish from the void

celestial_fisher.name: Celestial Fisher
celestial_fisher.description: A mystical rod that seems to bend reality itself.

perks.passive: Sometimes catches fish from other dimensions

lunar_dreamer.name: Lunar Dreamer
lunar_dreamer.description: Crafted from moonstone during a lunar eclipse.

perks.passive: Greatly increased rare fish chance at night

leviathan_lure.name: Leviathan Lure
leviathan_lure.description: Ancient rod said to have once caught a world serpent.

star_seeker.name: Star Seeker
star_seeker.description: Forged from a fallen star, it glows with cosmic power.

perks.passive: Can catch celestial fish during meteor showers
